hero.title:
Safety as our Foundation:
 The Engineering of Peace of Mind.
hero.subtitle: The Engineering of Peace of Mind.
hero.description:
In an industry often crowded by agencies lacking their own aircraft and competing on price alone, we are driven by rigorous checklists, uncompromising values, and technical passion.

Flying Pictures Mexico is built on a definitive philosophy: the thrill belongs in the vista, never in the risk. Discover why we are the valley’s only true aviation company.

legacy.subtitle: THE LEGACY
legacy.title: Corporate Discipline
legacy.description:
For ten consecutive years, the iconic Telcel Balloon—one of the most recognised aircraft in Mexican skies—was operated exclusively by Flying Pictures. Global corporations do not leave their brand equity to chance; they rely on operational discipline and proven safety records.

Our expertise includes complex missions, such as the precision landing of a commercial-grade balloon onto a vessel at sea—a feat made possible by seasoned pilots and technical operators. Today, we apply these same rigorous corporate aviation standards to your morning flight.

finest.subtitle:
Built in Bristol, 
Flown in Teotihuacán.
finest.title:
Engineering
 Excellence.
finest.description:
We maintain our fleet to the highest international aviation standards. Flying Pictures operates exclusively with Cameron Balloons (UK). Based in Bristol, Cameron is a global benchmark for lighter-than-air technology—the Rolls-Royce of the skies.

Their aircraft have set records for global circumnavigation and stratospheric flight. By choosing us, you are flying with some of the most advanced and prestigious engineering in the industry.

1.title: Hyperlast™ Fabric
1.description: High-performance material designed to withstand heat, tension, and intensive use without compromising the integrity of the envelope.

2.title: Thermal Resistance
2.description: Cameron technology designed to manage the demanding temperatures generated during regular balloon operations.

3.title: Operational Durability
3.description: Materials selected for dependable performance and a longer service life under demanding operating conditions.

4.title: Technical Maintenance
4.description: Every balloon is inspected and maintained with criteria that prioritise performance, traceability, and operational safety.

footer.title:
You’ve seen the specs.
Now see the view.
footer.description:
Safety is boring to read about, but it’s
wonderful to fly with.

tale.subtitle: FROM UK TO MX
tale.title: Tale of Two Countries.
tale.description: Flying Pictures brings together British heritage, technical experience, and a Mexican operation built for the Teotihuacán Valley.

1.title: 1978 (UK):
1.description: Flying Pictures is born in the United Kingdom, pioneering aerial cinematography for the BBC and Hollywood.

2.title: Mexico:
2.description: The experience arrives in Mexico with an operation focused on flights over Teotihuacán, safety, and premium service.

3.title: Corporate Aviation:
3.description: Commercial and branded balloon operations helped establish a culture of precision, maintenance, and technical responsibility.

4.title: Teotihuacán:
4.description: Our team adapts that international experience to the valley’s unique conditions, local weather, and sunrise operations.

5.title: Today:
5.description: Every flight combines heritage, Cameron technology, and protocols designed so you can enjoy the sky with confidence.

safety.subtitle: SAFETY PROTOCOLS & CONTROL TOWER
safety.title: The Invisible Wall of Safety.
safety.description:
How do we achieve a safety record that spans 30 years? By
 saying "No" when others say "Maybe."

1.title: The "Red Flag" Rule
1.description: Every component, from burners to carabiners, undergoes a rigorous check before each inflation.

2.title: Daily Inspections
2.description: If conditions are marginal, we stay grounded. We prefer to refund a ticket than risk a passenger.

3.title: Private Control Tower
3.description: We are the only company in the valley operating its own internal weather monitoring station. We track wind velocity and direction in real-time.

4.title: Verified Solvency
4.description: We operate with comprehensive liability insurance that exceeds legal requirements.

mastery.subtitle: OUR PILOTS
mastery.title: The experience begins with the people making the decisions.
mastery.description: Our team includes pilots who have flown at festivals and on projects in Mexico and abroad. Their work begins before you step into the basket: preparing the flight and explaining what you need to know. Once in the air, there is room to ask questions, talk, and discover the valley from their perspective.

1.label: EXPERIENCE
1.title: Experience across different skies
1.description: Pilots on our team have experience with balloon festivals and flight projects in Mexico and other countries. Each setting broadens the perspective they bring to Teotihuacán.

2.label: BEFORE TAKEOFF
2.title: Prepare and explain
2.description: A flight begins with preparation and clear guidance for passengers. It is a chance to understand the plan and ask questions before takeoff.

3.label: IN THE AIR
3.title: Share the valley
3.description: There is time for conversation, too: watching the balloons move, understanding the landscape, and hearing what the pilot notices from the basket.

meetGiants.title: Meet the Gentle Giants
meetGiants.subtitle: OUR FLEET
meetGiants.description: Every balloon has a name and a story of its own. At Flying Pictures, we fly Cameron Balloons aircraft and continue to invest in our fleet. Behind their colours is equipment we prepare and care for before each flight over the Teotihuacán Valley.
